items.title: SpaceX Stock Is Nearly 30% Below Its Post-IPO High. Here's What Facebook's Stock Did From the Same Spot.
items.summary: SpaceX stock has fallen approximately 29% from its post-IPO high of $201.80 to around $144. The article compares this to Facebook's similar decline after its 2012 IPO, noting that Facebook recovered only after demonstrating strong mobile ad revenue growth. SpaceX faces different challenges with massive capital spending on AI and other ventures, and investors should wait for the company to meet its Q1 2027 revenue guidance before considering it a buy.

items.title: Spotify (SPOT) Q3 Earnings Miss Estimates
items.summary: Spotify reported Q3 2026 earnings of $2.85 per share, missing the consensus estimate of $3.1 per share, representing an 8.07% earnings surprise. While revenue of $5.72 billion slightly exceeded expectations, the company received a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating due to unfavorable estimate revisions. The stock has underperformed the S&P 500 by 22.8% year-to-date.

items.title: Spotify (SPOT) Up 16% Since Last Earnings Report: Can It Continue?
items.summary: Spotify reported Q2 2026 earnings with 300 million premium subscribers and 777 million MAUs, beating guidance on user metrics. However, EPS missed consensus estimates, and subsequent estimate revisions have trended downward by 12.06%. The stock received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating despite strong growth fundamentals, suggesting in-line returns ahead.
